title: "Search strategy"

This page records the search, as PRISMA-S requires [@rethlefsen2021]. The counts are the records each database returned before deduplication. [01-deduplication](../analysis/01-deduplication.ipynb) writes the identification counts for the flow diagram from the exports in `data/raw/search_exports/` once the exports are in.

## Query

One query runs in Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed. Its terms are a form of *share* within five words of *data*, the phrase "open data" and the phrase "research data management", each in the titles and abstracts of records that contain *research\** or *scienti\**. The search covers sources published from 2015 to 2025 in English and French, with no document type filter.

| Database | Records | Known sources in the database | Matching the query |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| PubMed | 10,397 | 43 | 33 |
| Scopus | 39,441 | 70 | 58 |
| Web of Science | 28,134 | 65 | 50 |
| **Total** | **77,972** | **76** | **62** |
| Unique by DOI, or by title and year | 42,920 | | |

Platforms and search dates for the exports are to be added.

## Development and testing

**Method.** Following @hausner2012, the known relevant sources for testing candidate queries are the sources included by @chawinga2019. The paper does not list its 105 included sources, and we rebuilt a list of 102 from its references. Of the 102 sources, 85 have a DOI or PMID and 76 are in at least one of the three databases. The query's terms are the outcome of tests against these sources, so the result below is not an independent test of the query. Each test, with its code and files, is in the [search development notebook](../analysis/00_search-development/00-search-development.ipynb).

**Candidates compared.**

| Search | PubMed | Scopus | Web of Science | Total |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| share NEAR/5 data | 18,840 | 82,926 | 62,228 | 163,994 |
| (share NEAR/5 data) AND (research\* OR scienti\*) | 9,194 | 31,681 | 22,764 | 63,639 |
| **(share NEAR/5 data OR "open data" OR "research data management") AND (research\* OR scienti\*)** | **10,397** | **39,441** | **28,134** | **77,972** |

: Records for 2015 to 2025, before deduplication, on 25 November 2026. {#tbl-candidates tbl-colwidths="[64,9,9,9,9]"}

**Results.** Of the 76 known sources in at least one of the three databases, 62 match the query. The relative recall against these sources is 0.82 (95% interval 0.71 to 0.89). Of the 14 that do not match, 12 predate the review's period of 2015 to 2025.

**Limits.** The known sources date from 2007 to 2018, so the recall figure is for work published up to 2018. @chawinga2019 selected these sources under criteria that differ from this review's, and some fall outside its scope.

**Peer review.** A McGill health sciences librarian reviewed the search approach on 27 October 2026.

## Search strings

### Generic query

```text
Title/abstract: shar* NEAR/5 data OR "open data" OR "research data management"
AND
Title/abstract: research* OR scienti*

Limits: published 2015 to 2025; English or French
```

### PubMed

PubMed's proximity search takes no truncation, so the PubMed string spells out the four verb forms of *share*. Adding *sharers*, *shareable* and *sharable* returned 77 more records and no more known sources (run 4 in notebook 00).

```text
(
  ("sharing data"[tiab:~5] OR "shared data"[tiab:~5] OR "share data"[tiab:~5] OR "shares data"[tiab:~5]
   OR "open data"[tiab] OR "research data management"[tiab])
  AND (research*[tiab] OR scienti*[tiab])
)
AND 2015:2025[dp]
AND (english[la] OR french[la])
```

### Scopus

```text
( TITLE-ABS-KEY ( shar* W/5 data ) OR TITLE-ABS-KEY ( "open data" OR "research data management" ) )
AND TITLE-ABS-KEY ( research* OR scienti* )
AND PUBYEAR > 2014 AND PUBYEAR < 2026
AND LANGUAGE ( english OR french )
```

### Web of Science

```text
( TS=( shar* NEAR/5 data ) OR TS=( "open data" OR "research data management" ) )
AND TS=( research* OR scienti* )
AND PY=(2015-2025)
AND LA=(English OR French)
```

## Export file names

Name each export `<database>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.<ext>`, for example `scopus_2026-11-18.ris`. The date is the search date. Supported formats are RIS and CSV. See the README in `data/raw/search_exports/`.
